evidence.summary: The open Draft PR resolves to head c2503118b9c85e8d06d5538cf703517c58c94ee8; the remote branch matches it, and the repository contents API returns creative/car-concept/creative-development.json (14736 bytes).
The downloaded file decodes as H.264, 1920x1080, 30fps, duration 16.042667 seconds, size 6422178 bytes.

evidence.target: decoded frames from the downloaded Animatic
evidence.summary: Actual export pixels at 0.4s, 3s, 6s, 10s, and 14s were viewed. CONTACT isolates the wheel/brake; HUMAN CORE isolates the cockpit; SYSTEM shows ordered separation; CONVERGENCE visibly closes the structure; PRESENCE ends on the complete car. Titles and Chinese thesis lines are legible and do not create a dashboard layout.
The full control-plane acceptance passed the reusable skill contract, car-story preproduction contract, GitHub Pages repository policy, and aligned business/acceptance gate.

Validation through Animatic passes; confirmation validation and runtime-story generation both fail specifically because confirmation.status is pending rather than approved. docs/experiment has no diff from the declared baseline commit.
